column1: # Candidates from DPDK's history (the audit's checkout, 6bbb7b3) for a fix
# of a wrong single-producer or single-consumer declaration. Two searches
# of commit messages, run in that checkout (a blobless clone: messages and
# trees are local; reading a diff fetches its blobs; a search of the diffs
# themselves, git log -G, needs a full clone and was not run):
#   q2: git log -i -E --all-match --grep=fix --grep='(multiple|multi.?|two|several) (producer|consumer)s?|ring type|mempool ops|ring_(mp|sp)_(mc|sc)' HEAD
# 34 + 19 commits, 49 distinct. Each was read (subject, message, and the
# diff where the message leaves it open) and kept only if it fixes a
# declaration of one producer or one consumer that two threads broke.
